class.name: WorldTerrainDecorator
class.brief_description: Shared controls for deterministic terrain surface profiles.
class.description: Abstract base for terrain decorators attached through [member RegionContainer.decorators]. Profiles evaluate a three-dimensional signed field from a noise-shaped surface. Later sphere operations can still carve caves or add floating solids. Coordinates are relative to the owning container. Default priority is -100, before sphere operations at 0. Replacement after a cave will overwrite that cave inside the shared scope. These fields are not exact signed distances.

members.member: Vertical relief scale in metres. Zero produces a flat surface. Noise contributions are normalized across octaves.
How the profile combines with the earlier signed field. Defaults to replacement; use additive mode to preserve existing solid and subtractive mode to preserve existing air.
Base surface height in metres relative to the owning container. A translated container shifts the profile vertically.
Preview material ID: 1 earth, 2 green, 3 stone, 4 sand, 5 deep slate; other IDs use a fallback palette.
Number of noise layers, from 1 to 6. More layers add smaller details and increase sampling cost.
Deterministic noise seed. Regenerate the preview to publish parameter changes.
Horizontal noise scale in metres. Larger values spread features farther apart. This is a characteristic scale, not a repeating period.

constants.constant: Replace the earlier field and material inside the attachment scope.
Union the profile solid with earlier solid using the minimum field value. Cannot excavate existing terrain.
Intersect the earlier solid with the profile using the maximum field value. Removes solid above the profile; preserves earlier material IDs.
